tools.description: Use this when an agent would otherwise poll: get data pushed on a schedule (e.g. hourly BTC price) or when a trigger fires (BTC moves 2%, price crosses a level, a weather alert for a location, an airport delay, a new 10-K or 8-K). Delivery is a webhook and/or a 72 h mailbox; each delivery costs the same as one normal call, debited from prepaid credits (fund with buy_credits first); creating a feed is free. Omit credit_token on your first feed to open an account (a btf_ token is returned ONCE: store it). Example: create_feed(endpoint="btc_price", mode="trigger", trigger={"type": "btc_move", "percent": 2})

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_...), returned once by buy_credits or create_feed. Send it on every later feed or credit call.

endpoint.description: Endpoint to deliver: btc_intuitive, btc_stats, btc_pro, btc_signals, weather_intuitive, weather_stats, weather_signals, travel_intuitive, stock_filings or stock_fundamentals (deprecated aliases such as btc_price, btc_oracle, weather_now and airport_delays still work). Put its arguments in `params`.

interval.description: mode=schedule: 'hourly', 'daily' or a number of seconds (minimum 900).

interval_seconds.description: mode=schedule: the interval in seconds (alternative to interval).

mailbox.description: Also store deliveries in the mailbox (default true).

mode.description: schedule: deliver on an interval. trigger: deliver when the trigger condition hits.

trigger.description: Required when mode=trigger. type is one of: btc_move (percent, optional window_seconds), btc_threshold (above and/or below, in USD), weather_alert (location), airport_delay (airport, optional min_delay_minutes), sec_filing (symbol, optional forms; default 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K). Optional max_fires, expires_at, cooldown_seconds.

webhook_url.description: https URL to POST deliveries to. A signing secret is returned once.

tools.title: Create a feed (prepaid)

tools.description: Use this when you need to check your feeds: without feed_id it lists every feed and the prepaid sats balance; with feed_id it returns that feed's status, schedule and next delivery. Read-only. Example: get_feeds(feed_id="...")

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_...), returned once by buy_credits or create_feed. Send it on every later feed or credit call.

tools.title: List feeds or get one

tools.description: Use this when you want to change a feed: interval, trigger, params, webhook_url, mailbox, or pause/resume it with `state`. Only the fields you pass change. Resuming fails if the prepaid balance is zero or the feed expired. No charge. Safe to repeat.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_...), returned once by buy_credits or create_feed. Send it on every later feed or credit call.

feed_id.description: Feed id returned by create_feed or get_feeds.

state.description: paused stops deliveries; active resumes them.

trigger.description: Required when mode=trigger. type is one of: btc_move (percent, optional window_seconds), btc_threshold (above and/or below, in USD), weather_alert (location), airport_delay (airport, optional min_delay_minutes), sec_filing (symbol, optional forms; default 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K). Optional max_fires, expires_at, cooldown_seconds.

tools.title: Update, pause or resume a feed

tools.description: Use this when you no longer want a feed. PERMANENTLY deletes the feed definition and stops all future deliveries; this cannot be undone (create a new feed to restart). Deliveries already in the mailbox stay until they expire (72 h); the prepaid balance is untouched and non-refundable. Requires the account token and the feed id. Prefer update_feed state=paused if you may want it back.

tools.description: Use this when you will make many calls or run feeds and want to pay once instead of per call. Omit credit_token to open a new account: the result includes a btf_ token shown ONCE, store it. Lightning: pass bundle or amount_sats (100 to 1,000,000) to get an invoice, pay it, then call again with payment_hash and credit_token to credit it. USDC on Base (x402): pass bundle or amount_usd (0.10 to 50), sign accepts[0], call again with the same amount plus x402_payment; USDC is settled before crediting. Sats pay sats prices, USDC pays USDC list prices; spend with credit_token on any paid tool. Credits are NON-REFUNDABLE; a call that fails is refunded to the balance. Paused feeds resume after credit.

amount_sats.description: Lightning: sats to add (100 to 1,000,000). Alternative to bundle.

amount_usd.description: USDC over x402: dollars to add (0.10 to 50), e.g. "1.00".

bundle.description: A preset amount; see get_pricing for the sats and USD of each.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_...), returned once by buy_credits or create_feed. Send it on every later feed or credit call.

currency.description: With bundle: which currency to pay in.

payment_hash.description: Lightning: check this invoice and credit it if paid, instead of creating a new one.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
